qualifiers.condition: Larger workers are available in all AWS Regions where EMR Serverless is available.

note: d021. Posted Jul 7, 2026, before the 2026-07-15 examinable cutoff.

evidence.quote: Amazon EMR Serverless now offers larger worker configurations of 32 vCPUs with up to 244 GB of memory, allowing you to run more compute and memory-intensive workloads. Previously, the largest worker configuration available on EMR Serverless was 16 vCPUs with up to 120 GB of memory.

evidence.heading: Amazon EMR Serverless now supports larger worker sizes to run more compute and memory intensive workloads

evidence.quote: Larger workers are available in all AWS Regions where EMR Serverless is available.
